summary: V3-06 candidate adds domain services (syncEngine, invitationService, unitChangeService, authorizationRules, costInstrumentation), sync state tables (sync_cursors, sync_records, invitations) in SqliteStorage, repository sync methods, and a 731-line test suite. Trusted verification exit 0 reproduced (typecheck, tests, Expo export, prebuild, native debug BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 18m 15s). However the sync pipeline is not functional end-to-end: applyDeltas only writes pulled records into the sync_records buffer and never materializes them into business tables, while storeLocalRecords has zero callers so the push path is always empty; deterministic conflict resolution (resolveConflict) is dead code and applyDeltas performs blind last-write-wins. There is no invitation UI (no create/share/accept screen, no deep-link route) and no group-options UI (unit Minutes|Points and cross-ledger compensation toggle are unreachable in-app, leaving a dangling 'options du groupe' reference in balances.tsx). Authorization rules (tenant isolation, balance integrity) are only exercised in tests, not enforced in any data-access path. The V3-06 tests assert buffer/cursor mechanics only, never business-table materialization. No V3-01..V3-05 regression, no chrono/premium/paywall, no domain Firebase coupling, no N+1 or massive listeners in the new code; cost instrumentation with COST_BUDGETS is present and tested.

findings.problem: Sync is not functional end-to-end. applyDeltas only INSERT OR REPLACE into the sync_records buffer table and never materializes pulled payloads into business tables (contribution_entries, expense_entries, settlements, todo_items, persistent_tasks, members, memberships, households), so remote changes never reach business data. Conversely storeLocalRecords has zero callers anywhere in src, so local writes never populate sync_records and getDirtyRecords is always empty: pushDeltas never sends anything. The V3-06 acceptance criteria 'persistance et conflits gérés' and 'sync delta-only après quelques changements' are therefore not met by the product, only by buffer-level tests.
findings.evidence: InMemoryRepositories.ts applyDeltas:569 / storeLocalRecords:603 / getDirtyRecords:624; SqliteRepositories.ts applyDeltas:1168 / storeLocalRecords:1197 / getDirtyRecords:1213; index.ts applyDeltas:142 / storeLocalRecords:144 / getDirtyRecords:146; syncEngine.ts pullDeltas:58 / pushDeltas:104 / syncHousehold:146. git grep shows no caller of storeLocalRecords outside repository definitions and tests.
findings.requiredFix: Wire the sync pipeline into the product: (a) applyDeltas must materialize each pulled record into its business table (or the sync layer must replay the payloads through the ledger/use-cases) inside a transaction, then advance the cursor; (b) every local business write must record its dirty record via storeLocalRecords (or equivalent) so pushDeltas has real payloads; (c) add an end-to-end test proving a remote delta changes business data and a local write is pushed, not just buffer/cursor mechanics.
findings.verification: Independent grep of all callers of storeLocalRecords/applyDeltas; read of both repository implementations and syncEngine; read of v3-06 test file (731 lines) confirming tests only assert buffer/cursor state.

findings.path: app/ (no invitation screens) / app.json / src/application/ports/index.ts / src/domain/services/invitationService.ts
findings.problem: No invitation UI exists: there is no create-invitation screen, no share-sheet action, no accept screen and no deep-link route (app.json declares scheme 'chorescore' but no /join/:token route). The createInvitation port (ports/index.ts:130-131) and invitationService are only referenced by tests. The V3-06 criterion 'invitation create/share/accept testable' and the constitution §4 'parcours d'invitation réellement utilisable' are unmet.
findings.evidence: grep of app/ for invitation|Invitation|linkToken|join|Linking|deep.?link returns no invitation UI (only balances.tsx compensation references); app.json scheme 'chorescore' at line 9 with no routes; invitationService.ts createInvitation:76 / planInvitationAcceptance:130 have no UI callers.
findings.requiredFix: Add a real invitation flow: an invite action in the group (share sheet with the link), a deep-link route (e.g. /join/:token) that resolves the invitation and accepts it atomically (membership + member), and an honest adapter behind the existing invitation port. Keep the flow free of any plan/entitlement gating.
findings.verification: Independent grep across app/ and src/ for invitation entry points; read of app.json and invitationService.

findings.problem: No group-options UI: the group unit (Minutes|Points) and the cross-ledger compensation toggle/rate are unreachable in-app. balances.tsx gates compensation on crossLedgerCompensationEnabled and tells the user to activate it 'dans les options du groupe', but no such options screen exists, so the V3-06 criterion 'options groupe Minutes|Points + compensation' and the constitution §8 compensation flow cannot be exercised by a user. unitChangeService.planUnitChange is only used in tests.
findings.evidence: balances.tsx canCompensate gate (~line 519) and dangling 'Activez-la dans les options du groupe' text (~line 835); grep of app/ for options|unitChange|compensation finds no options screen; unitChangeService.ts planUnitChange:47 has no UI caller.
findings.requiredFix: Add a group-options screen reachable from the group (per constitution §3 'Options restent hors de la navigation principale') exposing: contribution unit Minutes|Points with explicit confirmation that historical entries keep their provenance/unit (no silent conversion), and the compensation toggle + group-defined rate. Wire it to unitChangeService and the household settings.
findings.verification: Independent grep of app/ for options/unit/compensation entry points; read of balances.tsx gate and unitChangeService.

findings.problem: Authorization rules are not enforced in any data-access path. requireHouseholdMembership/requireRole/assertLedgerWrite are only exercised by tests; no repository or use-case checks tenant membership before reads/writes, and nothing prevents balance falsification at the data layer. resolveConflict/resolveConflicts (authorizationRules.ts:127/143) are dead code: applyDeltas performs blind last-write-wins by (id, collection) without revision comparison, violating the constitution §9 and backend-frugal §9 requirement that accounting operations never be lost by blind LWW.
findings.evidence: authorizationRules.ts requireHouseholdMembership:42 / requireRole:65 / assertLedgerWrite:97 / resolveConflict:127 / resolveConflicts:143; git grep shows no production caller of these functions outside tests; applyDeltas in both repositories does INSERT OR REPLACE keyed by id only.
findings.requiredFix: Enforce tenant isolation and balance integrity in the data-access path (repository or use-case level): every read/write scoped to the caller's memberships, ledger mutations only through append/revision/tombstone, and applyDeltas must use the deterministic revision/timestamp/id conflict resolution instead of blind overwrite. Add hostile tests (cross-tenant read blocked, balance falsification rejected, concurrent same-id edits resolved deterministically).
findings.verification: Independent grep of all callers of requireHouseholdMembership/requireRole/resolveConflict; read of authorizationRules.ts and both applyDeltas implementations.

findings.problem: The V3-06 test suite (731 lines) covers invitation lifecycle, unit change and delta-only cursor mechanics, but never proves that a pulled delta materializes into business data or that a local write is queued for push. The 'sync delta-only' and 'persistance et conflits gérés' criteria are therefore only verified at the buffer level, which is why the non-functional pipeline above passes the suite.
findings.evidence: Test file read: sync tests assert initial pull revision 0, cursor advance, and delta-only fetch ranges; no assertion reads back a business table (e.g. contribution_entries) after applyDeltas, and no test calls storeLocalRecords.
findings.requiredFix: Add end-to-end sync tests: apply a remote delta and assert the business record is readable and balances are updated; create a local write and assert it appears in getDirtyRecords and is pushed; simulate a conflict and assert the deterministic resolver outcome. These tests must fail until the pipeline is wired.
findings.verification: Full read of the v3-06 test file; cross-check with repository implementations.
